Files.Name: jterrazz-base
Files.Text:

name: jterrazz-base

apps: [jq, gh]

Files.Name: linux-1
linux-dev
Files.Text:

name: linux-dev

Files.Name: macbook-pro
Files.Text:
machinefile: station.machinefile/v1
name: macbook-pro
machine: { kind: computer, system: { os: macos } }

apps: [lazygit]
